intro: Elder Windtotem is an honored ancestor spirit who appears on a bluff overlooking the goblin port of Ratchet during the Lunar Festival. Bathed in a radiant shaft of celestial light, she receives travelers seeking to honor the wisdom of ages past. Paying homage to her rewards mortals with an ancestral blessing and guidance toward other elders walking Kalimdor.

paras: Your spirit burns with life, young adventurer. I accept the homage you pay, and offer in return this token...
